images.alt_text: Pull request changes travel through a rules-based enforceable lane and a separate nonblocking AI advisory lane before human security review, repair verification and a merge decision.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The diagram clearly distinguishes enforceable rules-based findings from nonblocking advisory findings, joins them only at human security review and keeps excluded PR classes scoped to the advisory lane.

images.alt_text: A code-scanning alert enters an iterative repository exploration, repair and security-rerun loop, then exits to a draft pull request that still requires regression tests, abuse-case tests, reviewer approval and cost review.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The loop shows bounded iteration until the original alert closes, while the separate lower bench makes broader regression, abuse-case, human and cost review visibly independent.

images.alt_text: A business question crosses governed access, permission and semantic-definition rings before reaching federated warehouse, catalog and SaaS data without copying records, with query trace, approved-result comparison, denied-access testing and cost monitoring.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The radial atlas separates federation from copying and keeps permissions, semantics, traceability, approved-result comparison, denied-access behavior and cross-cloud cost visible.

images.alt_text: Approved curriculum, subject, book and chapter choices ground an editable lesson draft with visible sources, teacher review and differentiated classroom output, while pilot evidence, outcomes evaluation and human grading remain separate.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The open-book studio makes curriculum grounding, visible citations, editability, teacher review and differentiated materials central while explicitly separating pilot evidence from learning outcomes and keeping grading human-controlled.

images.alt_text: A reusable boundary-testing Skill evaluates job scope, identity, runtime bounds, observed traces and precise rules through allowed, denied and ambiguous cases, routing evidence to proof or human judgment without changing permissions.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Five trust layers surround three test types; precisely expressible cases go to proof, ambiguity goes to human judgment, and the verdict gate returns PASS, REVIEW or STOP while permissions remain unchanged.

images.alt_text: An agent rollout climbs through production definitions, one or two bounded actions, objective criteria, user testing and evaluation with fallbacks, while early users, sensitive-task review, cost and drift monitoring feed an evidence gate before autonomy expands.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The maturity staircase keeps readiness definition, narrow action scope, objective criteria, UAT, evaluation/fallback, user involvement, sensitive-task review and cost/drift observation upstream of the final evidence gate.

set_review.differentiation_evidence: Six inspected saved PNGs use six distinct causal grammars: dual security lanes, remediation verification loop, federated catalog atlas, curriculum grounding paper studio, autonomy boundary test matrix and evidence-gated production staircase.
